propositions: The deterministic link checker must validate repository-relative Markdown links across a maintained source boundary including root Markdown files and specified subdirectories while excluding .joe-janitor, .rebar/prompts, src/rebar/llm/reviewers, and tests/fixtures.

Relative link targets must resolve from their source directories to any location within the repository; targets escaping the repository or pointing to missing files must produce deterministic findings with source path, line number, raw target, normalized target path, and failure reason.

The checker must retain existing top-level docs index membership validation as a separate rule and scan inline Markdown links and images outside fenced blocks and inline code spans while stripping query strings and fragments before file resolution.
Scheme-qualified targets, fragment-only targets, fenced code blocks, and inline code spans must be ignored and produce no findings.
The duplicate outbound-link parser in test_all_docs_relative_links_resolve must be replaced with the unified checker API.
docs/documentation-policy.md must document the maintained source boundary, parser behavior, and exclusions replacing the stub description.
